This dashboard provides an overview of public sector performance across three key domains: economy, infrastructure and transport, and science, technology, and innovation.
 It analyses various indicators, including inputs, outputs, and outcomes, to assess how effectively countries deliver public services. The dashboard highlights differences in performance among countries, revealing insights into efficiency and effectiveness in service delivery.
